note: The frog's identifying features cannot share 36-40 units: pupils need eye rings of r>=9 (a centre dot 8+ from the ring), and two such eyes plus an 8 gap need 44 units of width; below the eyes only 22 units of height remain for a wide mouth (lens hole >=6 tall) plus 8 gaps plus the pointed collar, which needs about 30. Without pupils and mouth it is the rejected drawing.
